title: Independent eligibility review
scope: Review only your current assigned case under the objective identity policy. The buyer and this case’s brand approver cannot review it. Payment readiness is separate.
privateHint: Use a short policy explanation, at most 1,000 characters. Do not copy evidence or identity details.
recovery: No successful decision is confirmed. Retry the same reference. If access was denied or the scope changed, open the current assigned case.
receipt: This is a decision receipt. Current scope and consent must still be checked before preparing or consuming permission.
